# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Mar 20, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing L2 fork testing, improving conductor RPC functionality, and resolving critical CI stability issues, particularly mutex deadlocks in op-supernode.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Enhanced L2 Fork Testing Framework
A new L2 Fork Testing Framework has been added, providing robust infrastructure for generating upgrade bundles, forking L2 chains, executing bundles, and running tests via a `forge` wrapper. This significantly improves the ability to test L2 upgrades. ([#19464](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19464))

### Conductor RPC Improvements
The conductor RPC API now exposes the `DemoteVoter` method, allowing operators to demote a voting member to a non-voting member without requiring removal and re-addition of the node. ([#18700](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18700))

### Critical Bug Fixes and CI Stability
Key bug fixes include correcting `cd` paths in Kona action test recipes ([#19597](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19597)) and resolving a mutex deadlock in `VirtualNode.Start()` within `op-supernode` that caused CI tests to hang ([#19680](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19680)). Additionally, acceptance CI has been simplified and flake-shake removed, with tests now running directly via `gotestsum` and parallelized for efficiency. ([#19679](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19679))

### Superauthority Payload Handling
The `op-node` now drops unsafe payloads denied by the Superauthority that lack a `DerivedFrom` value, ensuring that post-derived payloads are not incorrectly applied. ([#19288](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19288))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#19689](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19689) fix(kona): fix action-tests-single CI job never running tests
- [#19688](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19688) fix(kona/genesis): continue past malformed logs in update_with_receipts
- [#19687](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19687) [NO-MERGE] fix(kona/derive): clear DAP on reset/activation signal in L1Retrieval
- [#19686](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19686) l1 retrieval: clear provider on reset
- [#19685](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19685) feat: opcm zk roots
- [#19683](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19683) fix(op-acceptance-tests): replace time.Sleep with deterministic block advancement in UnsafeChainNotStalling
- [#19682](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19682) fix(op-deployer): remove t.Parallel() from TestSuperchain to prevent CI flakes
- [#19678](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19678) fix(op-acceptance-tests): treat block removal as successful reorg detection

## CLOSED ISSUES

### L2 Contracts Manager Upgrades and Fork Testing
The issue related to setting up L2 upgrade fork testing infrastructure has been closed, following the successful implementation of a framework that generates upgrade bundles, forks L2 chains, and executes tests. ([#18837](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18837))

### Fault Proof System Refinements
Several issues concerning the fault proof system have been closed. This includes refactoring proof contracts to support `Creator` contracts ([#12421](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/12421)), making the `op-program` executor more explicit about supported game types ([#15032](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/15032)), and tracking the work to ship Kona + Cannon as a fallback fault proof option ([#17237](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/17237)). Additionally, blueprints for FDG and PDG will no longer be deployed ([#17262](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/17262)), and legacy dispute game contracts will be deleted ([#17263](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/17263)).

### CI Stability and Test Reliability
A non-terminating CI job has been addressed and closed, with the fix for a mutex deadlock in `VirtualNode.Start()` expected to resolve the issue. ([#19563](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19563))

## NEW ISSUES

### Flaky Test Reports
Two new flaky test reports have been filed. One concerns `TestSupernodeInteropInvalidMessageReplacement` which has shown multiple occurrences of "Condition never satisfied" during CI runs, indicating a potential issue with reset detection. ([#19677](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19677)) The other reports `TestCLELDivergence` failing due to the L2CLB unsafe head not exposing the target block, suggesting a potential bug in the reset logic. ([#19681](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19681))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-reth State Root Mismatch
The issue regarding recurring state root mismatches in `op-reth` on Base mainnet, leading to permanent sync stalls and fatal crashes, remains active. ([#19532](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19532)) Recent comments suggest a possible link to a `reth` issue and a recommendation to open the issue with Base for further investigation, especially given their recent OP Stack fork. Users on custom chains are also reporting similar issues.
